📌 Guide to export Cookie JSON using Cookie-Editor:
1. Install Cookie-Editor (or J2Team Cookies) browser extension.
2. Open Facebook (https://www.facebook.com) and sign in.
3. Click Cookie-Editor icon on toolbar ➔ Export ➔ Export as JSON.
4. Paste copied JSON below and click Save Configuration.

group_help_content:
Guide to input Facebook Group URLs:

• Group URL: https://www.facebook.com/groups/123456789 or https://www.facebook.com/groups/group-name/
• Any Post URL in group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/123456789/posts/987654321
• Numeric Group ID: 123456789
• Group Share URL: https://www.facebook.com/share/g/.../

⚡ When you enter or paste a post URL and blur, the system will automatically parse and normalize it to a valid group URL.
